name: Moktar Ould Daddah
contribution: A Mauritanian politician who served as the country's first president after it gained its independence from France.

checks.lead: Moktar Ould Daddah (Arabic: مختار ولد داداه, romanized: Mukhtār Wald Dāddāh; 25 December 1924 – 14 October 2003) was a Mauritanian politician who served as the country's first president after it gained its independence from France. Moktar served as the country's first Prime Minister from 1957 to 1961 and as its first President of Mauritania, a position he held for 18 years until he was deposed in a military coup d'etat in 1978.
